steps.code:
# Now fetch all friends and count those made since March 1, 2023.
access_token = login_response['access_token']
all_friends = []
page_index = 0
while True:
    page = apis.venmo.search_friends(access_token=access_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=20)
    if not page:
        break
    all_friends.extend(page)
    if len(page) < 20:
        break
    page_index += 1

# Count friends with friends_since >= 2023-03-01
count = sum(1 for f in all_friends if f['friends_since'][:10] >= '2023-03-01')
print(count)
